Class ActivityEntry

java.lang.Object
stockly.model.ActivityEntry
public class ActivityEntry extends Object
A single entry in the recent-activity feed.

Activity is recorded in memory for the current application session only. It is intentionally not persisted to disk: the feed is meant to show what the user actually did during this run.

Author:
Stockly Team
